finding: TSP-4 deficiency alters tendon collagen fibril size, soleus muscle ECM, and reduces VLDL uptake and grip strength.
limitation: Single-gene knockout; mechanistic links between ECM changes and metabolism not fully defined.

finding: Thbs4 stabilizes sarcolemmal membrane attachment complexes, with loss causing age-related dystrophy and overexpression protecting against muscular dystrophy.
limitation: Spontaneous dystrophy only in aged mice; cross-species findings combined.

finding: Thbs4 deletion does not worsen dystrophic phenotype in mouse models of LGMD2E or LAMA2-RD.
limitation: Contradicts earlier DGC-dystrophy studies; only two non-DGC models tested.

finding: THBS4 is enriched in young mouse serum and recombinant THBS4 increases dendritic arborization and synapse numbers in cultured neurons.
limitation: In vitro neuronal culture; in vivo role in brain aging not directly tested.

finding: THBS4 transcript abundance in skeletal muscle is modulated by six weeks of aerobic exercise training in humans.
limitation: Small cohort of healthy males; transcript-only without protein validation.

finding: Serum THBS4 levels differ between physically weakest and fittest older males, supporting its use as a frailty biomarker.
limitation: Sex-specific finding in males only; correlative cross-sectional design.

finding: THBS4 was identified as a predicted myokine hub upregulated after untrained eccentric exercise in humans.
limitation: Predicted, not biochemically confirmed myokine; short two-week training study.

finding: THBS4 is an elevated serum biomarker in mdx dystrophic mice, normalized toward wild-type by utrophin overexpression.
limitation: Mouse-only biomarker discovery; clinical DMD patient validation not performed.

finding: THBS4 is upregulated in pulmonary arteries across PH models, induced by HIF-1α and TGF-β1 via SMAD2/p38 signaling.
limitation: Animal PH models; therapeutic targeting experiments limited in scope.

finding: Secretory pathway transit is required for Thbs4 to augment sarcolemmal stability; Thbs4 deletion worsens mdx cardiomyopathy.
limitation: Uses artificial secretion-defective mutants; only cardiac mdx model examined.

finding: Thbs3 antithetically promotes sarcolemmal destabilization via integrin inhibition, augmenting injury-induced cardiomyopathy, unlike Thbs4.
limitation: Injury-induced model; differential constitutive versus inducible Thbs3 effects not resolved.

finding: Spatial transcriptomics identifies Thbs4 as a marker of fibrotic histopathological alterations in dystrophic mouse skeletal muscle.
limitation: Mouse-only; descriptive marker without functional in vivo validation.
